summary: The full Work index: a heading, a count of projects, a compact index and a preview of every project.
purpose: Shows every tool and platform in one place.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond its description. Likely reason: an archive view that sits alongside the home page.
how: 1) Sets the title and description. 2) Renders the navigation. 3) Shows the heading and a count taken from the project data. 4) Shows the index list. 5) Shows a preview for each project, with layouts that rotate through a fixed cycle.
inputs: The project list and the layout cycle.
risks: The count comes from the data and updates automatically. The layouts repeat in a cycle, so long lists reuse the same looks.
debug: If previews look out of order, check the layout cycle. If the count is wrong, check the project data.
